name: Nelson George Pringle

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Sarah Adula Copeland, daughter of Rev. Dr. David Copeland (President of Wyoming Seminary 1872-1882) and Sarah Wheelock.

bioAdditions: Nelson George Pringle was the only child of Alexander J. Pringle (H0142) and Mary Price. He was born at Kingston on 5 Apr 1860 and educated at Wyoming Seminary and Yale. By 1899 he had been a merchant in Kingston for about fifteen years and lived there with his widowed mother. On 3 Jan 1884 he married Sarah Adula Copeland, daughter of the Rev. Dr. David Copeland, president of Wyoming Seminary from 1872 to 1882, and Sarah Wheelock. Their daughters were Elizabeth (b. 14 Jan 1891) and Bertha (b. 30 Oct 1893) (S1). These are the Elizabeth H. and Bertha A. Pringle already on the site as Vassar graduates.
